prompt: Who was the oldest Miss Universe titleholder at the time of her crowning, cheered as a triumph over ageism in a youth-obsessed world?
answer: It was **Alejandra Marisa Rodríguez**, a 60-year-old lawyer and hospital legal adviser who was crowned **Miss Buenos Aires 2024**. She was celebrated as the oldest Miss Universe contestant, though she did not win the Miss Argentina title or compete at the Miss Universe final.
